title: Interlanguage CJK Mathematical Notation Backend

containing_record.title: Interlanguage and Mathematical Translation Methodology Sidecar

description: An additive component of the existing Interlanguage methodology sidecar: an evidence-backed shared mathematical document backend with independent Chinese, Japanese, and Korean locale profiles. It standardizes formula, provenance, build, extraction, and render mechanics without constructing a merged CJK language or allowing one language to authorize another.
